firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently ate an egg starts and takes the First Player token.
clarifications: Before the first turn, players choose a Dragon Egg card in reverse order, beginning with the player to the starter’s right.
Rounds proceed clockwise from the First Player.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF/printed page 3 states the egg criterion, First Player token and reverse-order egg selection; page 4 states clockwise rounds. Printed page 8 credits Synapses Games ©2019; incubator boards, Dragon Egg cards, market spinner and objective cards match inventory BGG 254427.
